sections.heading: Welcome back
points: We’re back for a new school year — welcome to our new families, and welcome home to returning ones.
A newsletter arrives here, under News, at the start of every month through May (May and June combined), with the month’s announcements, reminders and calendar.

sections.heading: Snack calendar
points: Every family takes one snack day a month — pick yours under Snacks.
Book as far ahead as you like; the app reminds you a week before and the day before.
Half days still need a morning snack.
What to bring, and what to avoid for allergies, is under Snacks → What to bring.

sections.heading: Blue bags and nap bags
points: Bring both on Mondays.
Blue bags come home every other Friday; send them back the following Monday.
Nap bags come home every Friday.
Keep nap items out of the blue bag — they’re stored separately.

sections.heading: Pickup
points: Please be on time; late fees apply.

sections.heading: Car line
points: Put a large sign with your child’s first name on the dashboard, and hold it out the window when the afternoon glare makes it hard for teachers to see.
Two lines, side by side. Dismissal runs 3:00–3:05.
Pull up to the next set of stairs before getting out to buckle your child, so the line keeps moving.

sections.heading: Show and Tell (Wednesdays)
points: Your child brings something they made — a drawing, a story, a Lego build — and presents it to the class.
Store-bought toys stay home.
It’s optional. Most children join in after a month or two; until then they can just watch.

sections.heading: Birthdays
points: No goodie bags. Instead, donate a book to the classroom — we’ll inscribe your child’s name and birthday in it.
Email the office about a week ahead so we can find a date that doesn’t clash with another celebration.

sections.heading: This month
points: No days off in September after Labor Day — closures for the rest of the year are under Calendar.
September is about routines: the more consistently your child attends, the easier the whole year goes.
Aim to arrive by 8:30. Drop-offs get easier — promise.
